independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Requests has a natural preparation-to-transport dependency: sessions and adapters consume PreparedRequest, Response, cookie, hook, authentication, URL, proxy, and body-length contracts. Package exports provide a narrow integration surface. The scoped evaluator avoids unavailable network fixtures, and the bootstrap mostly restores imports, although its small status-code and path passthrough behavior should remain documented as pre-supplied behavior.
